si4_title: Effects of anterior temporal lobe resection on cortical morphology

dc1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: The study utilized healthy control data from the Nathan Kline Institute (NKI) Rockland sample and a local cohort from the National Hospital for Neurology and Neurosurgery (NHNN), which is part of University College London (UCL). The TLE patient group was also recruited from NHNN and the Chalfont Centre for Epilepsy.
dc1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: We also used MR images of cross-sectional cohorts of 924 healthy controls, 91 of which were taken together with patients. Specifically, 22 were taken with scanning protocol 1 and 69 with scanning protocol 2 at the NHNN. The remaining 833 controls are subjects from the Nathan Kline Institute (NKI) data set (Nooner et al., 2012).

answer.UCL: normative training and clinical research (patient cohort)

dc2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: NKI dataset controls were used for normative training to ensure robust models across the age range. UCL controls (from NHNN) were used for normative training to inform effects for site-specific scanning protocols. The patient cohort (from UCL/NHNN/Chalfont) was used for the clinical study of ATLR effects.
dc2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: We used the controls to provide a normative model of age and sex with scanning protocol as a random effect. Even though the large NKI data set did not match the patients in scanning protocol, we used them for training to ensure we had robust models for the entire age range... The site-specific controls matching the patients then informed effects for the specific scanning protocols.
dc2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Leiberg2023.pdf.md: Section 2.5 / Age, sex and scanning protocol correction, L171-L178

normative_model.model-name: GAMM normative model for T, At, Ae

dc3_healthy_control_number_of_each_norma.detail: A total of 924 healthy controls (833 from NKI and 91 from NHNN/UCL) were used to construct the normative model using Generalized Additive Mixed Models (GAMM). The model was trained on the full set of controls to account for age, sex, and scanning protocol.
dc3_healthy_control_number_of_each_norma.supporting_text: We also used MR images of cross-sectional cohorts of 924 healthy controls... We used the controls to provide a normative model of age and sex
dc3_healthy_control_number_of_each_norma.location: Leiberg2023.pdf.md: Section 2.2 / Data & preprocessing, L136-L137; Section 2.5 / Age, sex and scanning protocol correction, L171

dc4_age_info_of_each_normative_model.detail: Specific age statistics (mean, SD, etc.) for the 924 healthy controls used in the normative model were not explicitly reported in the text or tables. However, the study mentions that the TLE patients were in the age range of 19-60 years and the NKI dataset was used to ensure the model was robust for this entire age range.

dc4_age_info_of_each_normative_model.location: Leiberg2023.pdf.md: Section 4.3 / Interpretations, L279; Section 2.5 / Age, sex and scanning protocol correction, L174-L175

dc5_sex_info_of_each_normative_model.detail: The control group of 924 individuals consisted of 562 females and 362 males. The percentages are calculated as 562/924 ≈ 60.8% for females and 362/924 ≈ 39.2% for males.
